description.value: The study investigated relationships between attentional bias for smoking-related words and fMRI brain reactivity to smoking-related versus neutral images in women smokers.

spans.text: Accordingly, in this study, we correlated behavioral performance on offline SES task with fMRI brain reactivity patterns to smoking-related vs neutral images.

value: we hypothesized that attentional bias to smoking words would be positively correlated with fMRI reactivity in brain regions mediating enhanced attention toward smoking images, including regions involved in emotion and recall of smoking-related memories.

spans.text: Therefore, we hypothesized that attentional bias to smoking words would be positively correlated with fMRI reactivity in brain regions mediating enhanced attention toward smoking images, including regions involved in emotion and recall of smoking-related memories.
